projects.description: Internal application for Crédit Agricole sales representatives to report and manage their commercial activities in order to qualify for a performance bonus. Organization by application unit, very sectorized. Front end with native technologies and Java Spring Boot back end. Implementation of ELK dashboard to create business indicators. Agile project with 4 to 6 developers, 2 business analysts and a product owner.

projects.shortDescription: Corrective and evolutive maintenance on stock market applications, covering securities and mutual fund (OPC) management.
projects.description: Crédit Agricole Titres: Java Spring Boot application with a JSP front end. Corrective and evolutive maintenance on stock market applications, covering securities and mutual fund (OPC) management.

projects.shortDescription: UX redesign of the incident reporting tool used for railway lines, both at stations and on board trains.
projects.description: Maintenance, evolution and corrective work on the SNCF incident reporting form. Application with strong ergonomic issues as users are stressed, work at night and are not IT professionals. The interface allows audio or textual entry of incidents on lines to display upcoming interruptions or slowdowns at stations, on board trains or on networks. Complete redesign on a one-page application. Feasibility study to migrate from AngularJS to Angular 16. Agile project with 2-6 developers with Scrum master, Product owner and product manager.

projects.shortDescription: Corrective maintenance and evolution of SNCF's technical monitoring stack.
projects.description: Development of a proof-of-concept application for display recognition in train stations and onboard trains using TensorFlow. In parallel, work as a big data developer on the monitoring component of SNCF applications using ELK. The objective is to provide both operational and technical indicators. Use of Google Analytics with a .NET component to create additional indicators such as traffic on SNCF media. Development of non-native plugins on Kibana. Agile project in a team of 4 to 6 developers with Scrum master, Product owner and product manager.

projects.shortDescription: Development of an internal application using JHipster.
projects.description: Development of a JHipster application with learning of versioning basics. The objective is to set up an internal gaming tournament application as part of corporate life. Developer intern in the innovation department.
